propositions: transition close commits STATUS event and releases lock before signing tail runs, causing SigningError on later completion signature append to be caught and silently dropped with exit 0
loss of completion signature is undetectable programmatically by callers because close_ticket payload carries no field reporting the signature outcome
stderr warning message presents lock timeout error as close failing when close actually succeeded

completion_signature field must be threaded through public API surfaces (_lib_writes.transition, CLI --output json, MCP transition_ticket) so callers can branch on machine-readable cause without parsing English
material drift refusal and force close must also report completion signature state with appropriate cause values
idea -> closed transition should not include completion_signature key in payload since rejection of undesigned idea is not a completion
